title: 若水汇·杭城三泉小卡产品图
note: 本套使用最新小卡设计，水款名称以参考图为准：西湖·虎跑泉、千岛·源水、径山·龙泉。

assets.name: 三款小卡组合图
assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / product-mockup. Create commercial product photography faithfully derived from the supplied NEW approved 若水汇 杭城三泉 bottle-and-hangtag design. This NEW reference supersedes previous packaging. Preserve the exact brand symbol of crossing fine mountain/water curves with small ring sun, restrained warm ivory palette and elegant Chinese serif branding. Focus on the collectible SMALL HANGING ART CARDS attached at the bottle neck: thin stiff printed paper/cardstock, off-white scalloped irregular cloud-shaped oval die-cut outline, delicate watercolor Chinese landscape, fine vertical calligraphic strip with tiny red seal, drilled top/bottom holes, fine colour-coordinated cord, one small translucent round bead at top and bottom, long fine silk tassel. They are flat paper illustration hangtags, not a thick jade pendant, plastic keychain, metal token or rectangular business card. Preserve the exact three distinct illustration/color identities from the reference: LEFT muted jade-green pavilion and garden stone steps with sage cord/beads/tassel; CENTRE mist blue lake and scattered mountain islands with dusty blue cord/beads/tassel; RIGHT warm ivory/sand ink mountains and a temple pavilion with pale golden-beige cord/beads/tassel. Existing vertical calligraphic label and tiny red seal should remain visual features, no added sales slogans, QR code or unrelated text. Fine believable printing, crisp die-cut edges and realistic tassel threads. Premium quiet daylight photography on warm pale limestone and ivory background. No website UI, collage panels, watermark or outer headline.
ASSET 1: A clean standalone THREE-CARD PRODUCT GROUP, without any bottles or cartons. Horizontal landscape 3:2 frame, approximately 1536x1024. Top-down flat-lay on warm ivory textured paper/stone. Three complete cards laid side by side at equal apparent scale, all illustrated fronts fully visible and unobstructed, left sage pavilion, centre blue island lake, right sand temple. Top cords form a gentle loop above each card, and the full beads and hanging tassels extend below each card. Card faces are almost straight to camera, not curved or perspective-distorted, allowing the illustration details to read. Overall set occupies about 75% frame width and 80% frame height with generous outer margins. Fine subtle contact shadows, very restrained soft leaf shadow only far away from the card faces. No loose random props, no packaging, no printed heading outside the three hangtags. Accurate small scale, delicate real paper, do not turn tags into large thick art plaques.
